question: For Young's double-slit experiment, $d = 0.5\text{ mm}$, $D = 1\text{ m}$ and $\lambda = 500\text{ nm}$. Determine whether a point $2\text{ mm}$ from the central fringe is bright or dark.

options.D: $\Delta x=\dfrac{dx}{D}=\dfrac{0.5\times10^{-3}\times2\times10^{-3}}{1}=1.0\times10^{-6}\,\text{m}$. Since $\lambda=5.0\times10^{-7}\,\text{m}$, $\Delta x=2\lambda$, which is an integral multiple of wavelength. Therefore, the point is bright.
